gen-fs-oswald-gf-quattrocento: Tall, tight and sure of itself, Oswald stacks its lines into dense rows. And Quattrocento relaxes beneath it, its thin strokes slightly slimmer than its thick ones, with plenty of daylight in every curve.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-radley: Radley reads dignified and authoritative, its counters letting the eye drift in and out of each word. Oswald, by contrast, packs its rows tightly and speaks with force, while Radley handles the quieter business of sturdy downstrokes and slender turns.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-roboto-serif: Oswald brings a confident, tightly knit look, low in contrast and strong in presence. Roboto Serif spaces its letters well apart, with wide eyes on every e and a and a mellow range of stroke weights.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sahitya: Strong, compact and bookish all at once. Sahitya, a text serif with thin strokes barely lighter than its thick ones, does the gentle work, while Oswald does the loud, tightly knit announcing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Oswald is all compressed, confident rows with little stroke contrast. Its strength shows when set big and short, while Sawarabi Mincho, a classic serif with terminals cut well short of the bowl, adds a lightly shaded texture to each word.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sedan: Oswald packs its text into tightly knit rows with barely any stroke contrast. Sedan, a text serif with mellow weights and terminals held far from the stroke body, loosens things up and gives the page a bookish, authoritative second voice.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sedan-sc: Literary and bookish, this pairing leans toward the shelf. Oswald earns its keep big and short, with tight confident rows, while Sedan SC, a classic serif with broad open counters, offers gentle stroke modulation underneath.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-shippori-mincho: Oswald stands up front with a confident, tightly knit look and very little stroke contrast. Make it small, though, and Shippori Mincho's modest, close-look contrast would take over.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-shippori-mincho-b1: Shippori Mincho B1 is a refined, editorial serif with a wide-open crescent c and hairlines of reasonable sturdiness. And Oswald stays tightly knit above it, confident and low in contrast, while the body's weight shifts subtly along each curve.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-spectral-sc: Literary and bookish, Spectral SC brings sturdy hairlines, moderate stems and wide mouths on its round forms. But Oswald, confident and tightly knit, sits beside it with a low-contrast punch that the body's calm modulation never fights.
